extracted.subtask_description: A landing/portal page describing resources, features, and participation items for K–12 civics and government teachers (lesson plans, primary sources, videos, classroom materials, and a classroom challenge). Not an evaluative rubric but lists requirements/features for participation and resource use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Videos: engaging and relevant
rubrics_metrics.description: Videos — Engaging and relevant for students and teachers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to be used in classroom instruction; selection criterion implied is that videos should be engaging and relevant to students and teachers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current Events Articles: classroom relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Current Events Articles — News articles relevant to topics in U.S. History, Government, and Civics classrooms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use as quick resources to connect classroom topics to contemporary events; relevance to U.S. History/Government/Civics is the stated criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Sources: full-text availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary Sources — Full texts of primary sources for U.S. History, Government, and Civics classrooms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides complete texts for classroom use; implied expectation that primary-source materials are authentic and accessible for teaching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pocket Constitution distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Pocket Constitution — Order Bulk Pocket Constitutions for Your Classroom / Request Pocket Constitutions for Your Classroom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural option for teachers to request or order materials to support classroom instruction and distribution to students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Star Challenge: use adaptable lessons to teach Declaration themes
rubrics_metrics.description: Participate by utilizing adaptable lesson plans and activities to teach the Declaration's themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the Civic Star Challenge (partnership with iCivics); participation requires integrating adaptable lesson plans and activities centered on the Declaration of Independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic Star Challenge: submit participation form
rubrics_metrics.description: Participate by submitting a simple form to showcase your class participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative requirement for Civic Star Challenge entry — teachers must fill out and submit a form documenting class participation to be counted/considered for prizes or recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educator Hub features: save, curate, share, and account creation
rubrics_metrics.description: Save Resources. Curate Playlists. Share Content. Create Educator Account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform functionality for educators to organize and share materials; implied quality standard is ease of curation and shareability of resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assign Student Work on the Go
rubrics_metrics.description: Assign Student Work on the Go.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature indicating resources and platform support assigning work remotely or quickly; implies expectations for mobile/quick assignment capability.
